title: 537: forecast movement
description: What the forecast changed its mind about.

items.title: Serie A: 1 club moved
items.content_text: Venezia's relegation risk fell from 36% to 30%.

items.title: Bundesliga: 2 clubs moved
items.content_text: Schalke 04's relegation risk fell from 54% to 43%. SV Elversberg's relegation risk rose from 15% to 25%.

items.title: Primeira Liga: 8 clubs moved
items.content_text: Marítimo's relegation risk fell from 43% to 19%. Académico de Viseu's relegation risk fell from 44% to 23%. Estrela da Amadora's relegation risk rose from 26% to 34%. Rio Ave's relegation risk rose from 23% to 30%. Casa Pia's relegation risk rose from 21% to 28%.

items.title: Championship: 6 clubs moved
items.content_text: West Ham United's title chance rose from 47% to 61%. Middlesbrough's chance of automatic promotion fell from 35% to 22%. Cardiff City's relegation risk fell from 22% to 11%. Wolverhampton Wanderers's chance of automatic promotion rose from 20% to 29%. Burnley's chance of automatic promotion rose from 20% to 28%.
